dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN NUCLEAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: Fresh syndication repeats the preliminary U.S. intelligence assessment already counted at 06Z: Mojtaba Khamenei may be more open to a nuclear deterrent, and secondary reporting repeats Israeli claims about centrifuges at Pickaxe Mountain. The intelligence predates his succession; Iran denies weapon intent, and no new IAEA access decision, weapons-grade production, detonation, or current weaponization order is verified. Raw 49; coupled 56

dashboard_trackers.name: IRAN WAR
dashboard_trackers.notes: PBS and USNI report that U.S. forces fired on and disabled another tanker trying to breach the U.S. blockade of Iranian ports. Iranian media separately claimed two crew deaths aboard an LPG tanker; that casualty claim was not independently confirmed. Hormuz transits remain low while mediated contacts continue. Raw 100; coupled 100

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL-LEBANON
dashboard_trackers.notes: The reported ceasefire and U.S.-backed talks remain the main constraints. Reporting describes continuing Israeli demolitions in southern Lebanon and Lebanese conditions for Hezbollah disarmament, but no fresh Hezbollah strategic attack, mass-casualty event, or collapse of talks surfaced. Raw 81; coupled 91

dashboard_trackers.name: TURKEY-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: No verified Turkish combat entry, force movement toward Iran, official nuclear-doctrine shift, or long-range launch surfaced in the rolling 24-hour review. Raw 5; coupled 5

dashboard_trackers.name: INDIA-PAKISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: The Rawalakot item returned by the exact lane was dated July 14. No fresh Line of Control exchange, Indian force movement, or India-Pakistan strike was verified in the past 24 hours. Raw 15; coupled 15

dashboard_trackers.name: PAKISTAN-AFGHANISTAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reporting continues to focus on the deadly Tank district militant attack and Pakistan-Taliban accusations. No fresh Pakistan-Afghanistan state-on-state border strike, crossing closure, or sustained interstate clash was verified. Raw 46; coupled 46

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-UKRAINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: Al Jazeera reported at least 11 people killed in Russian and Ukrainian strikes, while follow-up reporting described Ukraine's continuing deep-drone campaign. These sustain the active war's high intensity but do not establish direct NATO entry or a nuclear-posture change. Raw 99; coupled 99

dashboard_trackers.name: RUSSIA-NATO
dashboard_trackers.notes: Romania's confirmed second drone shootdown remains under investigation and Allied coordination continues. No attribution for the second drone, third incursion, casualty, or NATO Article 4/5 step surfaced; NATO's official pages showed no new collective-defence action. Raw 51; coupled 61

dashboard_trackers.name: CHINA-TAIWAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Current Taiwan reporting concerns Taiwan's counter-blockade preparation and previously reported Chinese activity. No new PLA quarantine, blockade declaration, amphibious mobilization, or military clash surfaced in the past 24 hours. Raw 24; coupled 28

dashboard_trackers.name: DPRK
dashboard_trackers.notes: Zelensky said North Korea may supply Russia with new ballistic-missile launchers, but this remains one claim chain. No fresh DPRK launch, atomic detonation, or major Korean Peninsula force movement surfaced. Raw 18; coupled 18

dashboard_trackers.name: SUDAN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Sudan Tribune and TRT World reported army/allied recapture claims for key North Kordofan towns. The reports indicate a material frontline shift, but no independent confirmation, El Obeid capture, or Port Sudan threshold surfaced; the near-ceiling score is held. Raw 92; coupled 92

dashboard_trackers.name: ISRAEL PALESTINE
dashboard_trackers.notes: The West Bank shooting and subsequent operation remain the main threshold: four Palestinians and two Israelis were reported killed and more than 70 people detained. Later syndication added no distinct new mass-casualty or holy-site event. Raw 96; coupled 96

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH SUDAN ABYEI
dashboard_trackers.notes: No fresh military clash, verified large force movement, or Abyei security shift surfaced. Election and regional diplomatic risk remain the principal watch items. Raw 19; coupled 19

dashboard_trackers.name: EASTERN DRC
dashboard_trackers.notes: Renewed M23-Wazalendo clashes and reinforcement remain the latest threshold. No independent confirmation of a new strategic capture, mass recruitment, or direct Rwanda-DRC clash surfaced. Raw 56; coupled 56

dashboard_trackers.name: YEMEN RED SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: Reuters reported Saudi air defences intercepted missiles aimed at Yanbu refineries, verified smoke toward the Jizan refinery, and cited two trading sources reporting some damage; Saudi authorities and Aramco gave no immediate damage or outage confirmation. Saudi-Houthi strikes and front-line reinforcement remain active. Raw 84; coupled 84

dashboard_trackers.name: MALI SAHEL
dashboard_trackers.notes: The geolocated Shahed-type attacks and likely Russian support remain the latest threshold. No new verified Mali drone strike, casualty toll, operator attribution, or strategic JNIM seizure surfaced. Raw 39; coupled 39

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTH CHINA SEA
dashboard_trackers.notes: Philippine and Chinese accounts continue to describe the already-counted second straight day and third faceoff of the week near Scarborough Shoal. The Philippine fuel mission proceeded despite water-cannon use; no fourth encounter, casualty, vessel loss, or treaty consultation surfaced. Raw 27; coupled 27

dashboard_trackers.name: SOMALIA GULF OF ADEN
dashboard_trackers.notes: Multiple regional reports continue to place M/T Asana under pirate control. No rescue, second hijacking, casualty, or naval engagement was verified; a separate Somali army operation in Hiiraan is outside this maritime tracker's threshold. Raw 28; coupled 28

dashboard_trackers.name: SOUTHERN THAILAND
dashboard_trackers.notes: Thailand's NSC chief described Malaysia as important to the southern peace process. Expanded security measures and the border-fencing plan remain active, but no new attack, province expansion, or confirmed cross-border spillover surfaced. Raw 25; coupled 25

dashboard_trackers.name: KUWAIT IRAQ BORDER
dashboard_trackers.notes: Kuwait's pledge to reopen the Abdali crossing within 48 hours remains the latest operational change. No reopening confirmation, repair completion, closure extension, or additional border drone attack surfaced. Raw 19; coupled 19
